summary: On June 25, 2133, Bob tests the capabilities available to him as software. Dr. Landers advances his training from a simple manipulator arm to remotely directed ROAMers, and Bob quickly learns to coordinate the semi-autonomous machines through increasingly complex exercises. His success is tempered by noticing that the training room is heavily sealed and wondering whom its security is meant to contain.

introducing.name: ROAMers
introducing.description: Remote observation and manipulation devices that Bob directs through the GUPPI interface.

introducing.name: VAST
introducing.description: Variable Attachment Surface Tension is a system that gives a ROAMer a secure grip.
